# Alert: `jl-alert`

A message in the page, coloured by its tone: a tip, a success, a warning, a failure.

- Class `JlAlert`, a molecule: `import { JlAlert } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/alert

An alert is a message in the flow of the page, coloured by its tone: info for a tip, ok for a success,
warn for something to check, danger for a failure. For a message that comes and goes on its own, use a toast.

Warnings and failures are role="alert", which interrupts a screen reader; the other tones are role="status", which
waits for a pause. Each tone has its icon: a sign filled in the tone's colour (the accent's sparkles stay drawn as
lines); icon names another one, drawn as lucide draws it, and icon="none" shows none.

## Use

```ts
import { JlAlert } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlAlert dismissible heading="Scheduled maintenance" tone="info">
  The app will be read-only on Sunday from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC.
</JlAlert>
```

```html
<jl-alert dismissible heading="Scheduled maintenance" tone="info">
  The app will be read-only on Sunday from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC.
</jl-alert>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `tone` (attribute `tone`): `'info' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' | 'neutral' | 'accent'`, default `'info'`. The colour and the icon, by meaning; warn and danger interrupt screen readers.
- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. A bold line above the text.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. The message as plain text, set from code; links and markup go in the default slot.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon instead of the tone's own; none shows no icon.
- `dismissible` (attribute `dismissible`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows an × that hides the alert and fires dismiss.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `dismiss` (`onDismiss` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The × of a dismissible alert was pressed; the alert is now hidden.

## Slots

- The default slot: The message, when it needs links or markup.
- `actions`: Buttons under the message.

## Methods

- `dismiss(): void`: Hides the alert as its × does, and fires dismiss.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The alert.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Tones

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-alert>A new version is available. It installs the next time the app starts.</jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="ok">Your changes are saved.</jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="warn">Your card expires at the end of the month.</jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="danger">The import failed: 3 rows have no email address.</jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="neutral">This project is archived. It can be read, not changed.</jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="accent">Try the new editor: it is faster, and works offline.</jl-alert>
</div>
```

### With a heading

The text in the slot, or in description when it is plain and set from code.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-alert tone="danger" heading="The payment did not go through">
    The bank declined the card ending in 4242. Check its details or use another card.
  </jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="ok" heading="Domain verified" icon="shield-check"
    description="example.com now sends email signed with your key."></jl-alert>
</div>
```

### With actions

Buttons in slot="actions", under the text.

```html
<jl-alert tone="warn" heading="Two-factor authentication is off">
  Anyone with your password can sign in. Turn it on to protect your account.
  <jl-button slot="actions" size="sm" variant="primary" label="Turn on"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" size="sm" variant="ghost" label="Remind me later"></jl-button>
</jl-alert>
```

### Dismissible

The × hides the alert and fires dismiss.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-alert class="demo-dismiss" tone="info" dismissible>You can now invite guests to a project.</jl-alert>
  <jl-alert tone="neutral" icon="none" dismissible>No icon, and an ×.</jl-alert>
  <div class="row"><jl-button class="demo-again" size="sm" icon="refresh" label="Show again"></jl-button></div>
</div>
```

```js
const alert = root.querySelector('.demo-dismiss');
root.querySelector('.demo-again').events.register('press', () => {
  alert.hidden = false;
});
```
